name: Hunt Startup

sources.title: Submit page — renders the 'Join the Club' signup/signin wall
Pricing page — Starter $0 (badge for dofollow), Featured $10/week, Premium $7 one-time

conditions: Free Starter listing requires account creation and publishes a nofollow link; embedding the Hunt Startup badge on your site upgrades it to a dofollow backlink
Free listings are 'Processed within 24 hours' per the pricing page
requirements: Early-stage startups, SaaS, AI tools and tech products (site positioning)
Account required: /submit shows a signup form (Google or full name + email + password)
For a dofollow link on the free plan: embed their badge on your site
preparation: Startup name, URL, category (SaaS, AI, Marketing, Productivity, DevTools, Fintech, etc.) and description
Ability to add an HTML badge to your site footer if you want the free dofollow link
Decide plan: Starter $0 / Featured $10 per week (8 spots, 7 days homepage) / Premium $7 one-time (permanent dofollow, no badge, fast approval)
workflow: Create an account at /auth?mode=signup (or sign in with Google)
Enter startup details and choose the plan
For Starter+dofollow: add the badge to your site so it verifies
Submit; Starter claims processing within 24 hours
watchFor: Free tier link is nofollow unless the badge stays embedded — treat badge as a permanent obligation if you want dofollow
Featured is billed weekly ($10/week, cancel anytime) — it is not a one-time charge
Footer carries dozens of reciprocal directory badges — classic badge-exchange directory network; expect the free tier to exist mainly for the badge link
countsAsLive: A startup detail page at /startups/<slug> linked from the directory with name, description, category and 'Visit Website' link
unknowns: Whether free listings are manually reviewed or auto-approved
Exact badge embed code location (behind the account wall)
